hooks.command: CMD=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if printf '%s' "$CMD" | grep -qE '(^|[|;&(`$])[[:space:]]*(cp|rsync|install|mv|ln|tee)([[:space:]]|$)' && printf '%s' "$CMD" | grep -qE '(\$HOME|~|/Users/[^/]+|/home/[^/]+)/\.config/|\$CONFIG/|\$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/'; then jq -nc '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:"Direct writes into ~/.config bypass ./deploy.sh (which maintains the source→dest mapping and verifies each copy). Run ./deploy.sh from the repo root instead."}}'; fi

FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); REPO="/Users/seth.woodworth/code/lcarcat"; case "$FILE" in "$REPO"/*) REL="${FILE#$REPO/}";; *) exit 0;; esac; if grep -qF -- "\"$REL " "$REPO/deploy.sh" 2>/dev/null; then echo "auto-deploy: $REL is mapped by deploy.sh — running ./deploy.sh" >&2; (cd "$REPO" && ./deploy.sh) >&2; fi
